name: jsdom
reason: DOM/browser emulation. Its XML documents (DOMParser 'application/xml', XML content types) are parsed by saxes (imports saxes ^6.0.0); HTML goes through parse5. Shares the selected saxes family; not run.

name: htmlparser2
reason: Own forgiving HTML tokenizer with an xmlMode option; it does not enforce XML well-formedness or resolve namespace URIs, so it is not an XML 1.0 + Namespaces parser. Not run.

name: fast-xml-parser
reason: Own string scanner (OrderedObjParser) and validator behind XMLParser.parse(Buffer, true); no namespace URI resolution, so the adapter resolves prefixes from in-scope xmlns attributes. Both valid namespace-aware controls match the expat oracle, with pinned npm integrity, V8 package-source coverage, and input-dependent AFL++ feedback verified.

name: @xmldom/xmldom
reason: Promoted to verified: own XMLReader tokenizer and DOM builder; strict UTF-8 local-text adapter matches the expat oracle on both controls.

name: xml2js
reason: Imports sax and builds objects from its events; shares the sax family. Not run.

name: xmlbuilder2
reason: Builder/serializer whose create(string) parsing goes through @oozcitak/dom's XML string lexer; the parser is a secondary feature. Not run.

name: xml-js
reason: Converts via sax events (optional node-expat import); shares the sax family. Not run.

name: xmldoc
reason: Lightweight DOM built on sax events; shares the sax family. Not run.

name: @xml-tools/parser
reason: Chevrotain-generated XML CST parser for editor tooling (parse({text})); string-only and no namespace resolution in the CST. Not run.

name: xmldom
reason: Deprecated unscoped predecessor (0.6.0) of the selected @xmldom/xmldom; same XMLReader/DOMHandler family. Not run.

name: libxmljs2
reason: Native binding to libxml2 via node-gyp/prebuilt binaries; parser source is C, not JavaScript. Native build not attempted.

name: txml
reason: Small own string scanner (parse(string)) without namespace resolution. Not run.

name: @rgrove/parse-xml
reason: Own spec-oriented XML 1.0 parser (parseXml(string)); does not resolve namespace URIs. Not run.

name: sax-wasm
reason: Rust SAX parser compiled to WebAssembly; parser source is not JavaScript. Not run.

name: xml-parser
reason: Small regex-based parser, last released 1.2.1; no namespace resolution. Not run.

name: node-expat
reason: Native binding to libexpat; parser source is C. Native build not attempted.

name: ltx
reason: XMPP element library with pluggable backends (own ltx parser, sax, saxes, node-expat, libxmljs). Not run.
